purpose: Measure disaster-related loss of access to essential services and report its distribution across population groups or locations.

mathematical_formulation.distribution: Report {L_i^x} and group summaries separately from L_x

unlock_rule: Disabled until origins, opportunities, weights and an impedance function are confirmed; topology alone cannot support an equity claim.

primary_sources.citation: Taylor, Sekhar and D'Este (2006), Accessibility-based vulnerability analysis of strategic road networks, Networks and Spatial Economics.
Sohn (2006), Evaluating highway network links under flood damage, Transportation Research Part A.

known_limitations: Results depend on opportunity and impedance definitions.
A weighted mean can conceal distributional losses.
Accessibility loss is not equilibrium congestion or realised behaviour.
